_comment: Followers that walk with the character for so many minutes from the moment he is given them (their
805, «Recibido el»), with nothing on the item the client would show: the minutes are written in the
item's description or said by whoever hands it over. FollowerLifetimes reads it; AlterationHandler
takes the follower out of his slot when they are up.

followers.why: «Get Your Fresh Snapper Here!» (579): the domesticated pingwobble's description, «su digestión comienza al cabo de treinta minutos» (37776), and Al Fabeticorder handing it over (7858). Dofus pour les noobs: «Vous avez cependant 30 minutes maximum pour arriver à destination».
